name: BBQ It
desc:
🥩 Grill, sell and show off different varieties of meats!

🔥Your grills stay on while offline so you can keep cooking!

🍽️ Theres no limit to how heavy your items can weigh, whats the heaviest you can get?

Start by placing your grill and table
Grill meat to the perfect temperature
Accept the highest offer and profit

If you enjoy the game be sure to like and favorite!
